name: Sofina
source:
She is the daughter of the hero who defeated the Demon King. She rarely expresses her emotions, does not talk on her own, and does not try to get involved with others. This is because she has been seen as the "daughter of a hero" since she was a child, and has spent her life not being able to get along with others. She's full of talent and wants to be like her father.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/darklord/character.html#chr01]official website[/url]]
